bio.text: Scott Colom is the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate in Mississippi in the November 3, 2026 election.
Colom is the district attorney for Mississippi's 16th Judicial District, which includes Lowndes, Oktibbeha, Clay and Noxubee counties.
Colom was born and raised in Columbus, Mississippi, where the district attorney still lives, and earned a law degree from the University of Wisconsin-Madison.
President Joe Biden nominated Colom in October 2022 to the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Mississippi, but the Senate did not consider the nomination.

sources.title: Meet the Candidates for US Senate in Mississippi's Nov. 3 Elections
